images.alt: Background shows a blurred image of a tree bent sideways by the wind on a hill by the sea. A heading reads "Game night gusts observed in Wellington, Saturday 20 June 2026, 6 to 9pm". A table of gust speeds in kilometres per hour reads "Kaukau 146 Kelburn 119 Airport 106 Lower Hutt 89 Upper Hutt 81 Aotea Quay 72".

post.text:
What about those Hurricanes???

As a Wellingtonian and a meteorologist, I'm a little biased, but I reckon we have the most regionally-appropriate name in Super Rugby 💨

Aotea Quay, over the road from the Cake Tin, had several 72km/h gusts during the game, while Hamilton only managed 22km/h 💪

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
